name: Ishmaelites
overview: The Ishmaelites, identified in Scripture as both merchants and Midianites, occupied the region from Havilah to Shur near Egypt (Genesis 25:18). They are notably involved in the narrative of Joseph, where they come from Gilead bearing valuable goods and are the recipients of Joseph when sold by his brothers (Genesis 37:25-28). This group is also described as enemies to Israel, and the terms Ishmaelites and Midianites are used interchangeably in the biblical text, highlighting their intertwined identity and role in Israel's history.
